source: 2021/TSB Vol. 21 No. 03 - New Honda CVT ATF adapter.pdf
title: Honda ATF Adapter
lead: MOC has developed a new transmission adapter to be used in the Honda CVT transmissions. This adapter is Part No. 94953. This adapter connects to the pressure sensor port on the transmission permitting a quick and reliable transmission fluid exchange.
body: The pressure sensor location is shown in the diagram below as item number 9.
